items.title: Jim Cramer Says Home Depot Beat but Gave a ‘Tepid’ Forecast. Why He Calls It a Rate Stock
items.summary: Home Depot topped earnings estimates, yet shares slid as investors read the fine print on next year. Jim Cramer says the real driver sits outside the company's control, and a few numbers show why the stock has gone nowhere for years.

items.title: Home Depot Just Updated Its Full-Year Outlook. Here’s the Price Target to Watch
items.summary: Home Depot beat estimates, lifted its sales guidance, and handed the CEO job to Richard McPhail, yet the stock slipped. A frozen housing market and thinning margins complicate the story, and our model reveals how far it believes shares can still climb.

items.title: Target Pays the Higher Yield. Lowe’s Has Wall Street on Its Side. Which Wins for Retirees?
items.summary: One retail giant sends bigger dividend checks, while the other has analysts cheering and a housing slump hanging over it. For income-hungry retirees, the winner depends on which risk feels easier to live with, and the scorecard may surprise you.
